profile.legalName: Businesses United In Investing Lending And Development
profile.summary: BUILD is a nonprofit that teaches entrepreneurship to high school students in under-resourced communities. It works with partner schools and fits its curriculum into Career Technical Education pathways, where students design and launch small businesses. It serves over 1,500 students a year in California.
